# Fresh TRACE repository fixture

The committed `.trace` files were generated by the real `trace init --yes` CLI
in an isolated directory named `trace-project`. They contain no environment,
authentication, dashboard binding, sync acknowledgement, or analysis data.

Git preserves only the three deterministic scaffold files, not empty directories.
The CLI regression test initializes a temporary repository, verifies every expected
directory and byte-compares its scaffold with this fixture, then validates both
with the TRACE schema. Runtime files remain ignored even inside this fixture.
To exercise it locally, copy this example outside another Git checkout, run
`trace init --yes`, then `trace validate`. Normal first use is:

```text
trace init --yes
trace login
trace connect
trace analyze
trace sync --dry-run
trace sync
```
